text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san...!
Here are some refreshments from everyone!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You just had a race recently, so I've gathered everything you'll need to blow that fatigue away!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tired, huh... Haha, you're worrying too much!
But thanks. I'll eat it later.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Whaddya want?
Is there somethin' on my face?

Looking back, her recent movements
seemed to lack their usual luster.
Perhaps we should review her schedule.
